title: The Auslander--Reiten conjecture for quantum complete intersections
summary: Let \(A\) be a finite-dimensional quantum complete intersection over an arbitrary field. We prove that a finite-dimensional left \(A\)-module \(M\) is projective whenever \(\Ext_A^1(M,M)=\Ext_A^2(M,M)=0\), with no restriction on the multiplicative orders of the commutation parameters. Consequently, \(A\) satisfies the Auslander--Reiten conjecture and Tachikawa's second conjecture. The proof combines the gradability of rigid modules with successive graded twists and the self-extension criterion of Avramov and Buchweitz for commutative complete intersections.
